name: Arcane Artist

source.note: Compared with the published D&D Beyond chapter on 2026-10-06: https://www.dndbeyond.com/sources/dnd/au/chapter-1-character-options.

summary: Always prepared: Minor Illusion; choose Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma for casting. After casting an Illusion spell, grant Heroic Inspiration to one ally within 30 feet who can see you. Once per Long Rest.
